rows.text: Willing Sacrifice I<tab>Clear the board with 3 incapacitated familiars.
Willing Sacrifice II<tab>Clear the board with 2 incapacitated familiars.
Willing Sacrifice III<tab>Clear the board with 1 incapacitated familiar.
No Beast Left Behind<tab>Clear the board with no incapacitated familiars.
Beast Squad I<tab>Clear the board with a team of 6 or 7 familiars.
Beast Squad II<tab>Clear the board with a team of 4 or 5 familiars.
Beast Squad III<tab>Clear the board with a team of 1 to 3 familiars.
Self-preservation<tab>Clear the board with beastmaster HP at 100%.
Selfless<tab>Clear the board with all familiar HP at 100%.
Infinity and Beyond I<tab>Perform Universality at least 5 times.
Infinity and Beyond II<tab>Perform Universality at least 10 times.
Infinity and Beyond III<tab>Perform Universality at least 15 times.
Unbeastable<tab>Clear the board without being afflicted by Damage Down or Vulnerability Up.
Nameday Attire<tab>Clear the board without acquiring any beast gear.
Walking Armory<tab>Clear the board in possession of 10 pieces of beast gear.
Economic Ethos<tab>Clear the board without using crucible items.
Habitual Hoarder<tab>Clear the board in possession of 10 crucible items.
Starve the Fever<tab>Clear the board without feeding any familiars.
Feed the Bold<tab>Clear the board having fed your familiars at least 20 times.
Coin Clutcher<tab>Clear the board without spending territory tokens.
Rolling in Riches<tab>Clear the board in possession of at least 2,000 territory tokens.
Sleepless Survival<tab>Clear the board without resting at a campsite.
Beastkin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only beastkin.
Vilekin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only vilekin.
Cloudkin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only cloudkin.
Seedkin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only seedkin.
Wavekin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only wavekin.
Scalekin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only scalekin.
Soulkin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only soulkin.
Ashkin Gambit<tab>Clear the board with a team of only ashkin.
First Degree<tab>Clear the board under the first degree.
Second Degree<tab>Clear the board under the second degree.
Third Degree<tab>Clear the board under the third degree.
